verses.en: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.
verses.pt: Josias tinha oito anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou trinta e um anos em Jerusalém. O nome de sua mãe era Jedida, filha de Adaías, de Bozcate.
verses.en_web: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jedidah the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.
verses.en_bbe: Josiah was eight years old when he became king; and he was ruling in Jerusalem for thirty-one years; his mother's name was Jedidah, daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.

verses.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in all the way of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.
verses.pt: Ele fez o que era reto aos olhos do Senhor; e andou em todo o camimho de Davi, seu pai, não se apartando dele nem para a direita nem para a esquerda.
verses.en_web: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and walked in all the way of David his father, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left.
verses.en_bbe: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord, walking in the ways of David his father, without turning to the right hand or to the left.

verses.en: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, that the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of the LORD, saying,
verses.pt: No ano décimo oitavo do rei Josias, o rei mandou o escrivão Safã, filho de Azalias, filho de Mesulão, à casa do Senhor, dizendo-lhe:
verses.en_web: In the eighteenth year of king Josiah, the king sent Shaphan, the son of Azaliah the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to Yahweh’s house, saying,
verses.en_bbe: Now in the eighteenth year after he became king, Josiah sent Shaphan, the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of the Lord, saying to him,

verses.en: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the LORD, which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people:
verses.pt: Sobe a Hilquias, o sumo sacerdote, para que faça a soma do dinheiro que se tem trazido para a casa do Senhor, o qual os guardas da entrada têm recebido do povo;
verses.en_web: “Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may count the money which is brought into Yahweh’s house, which the keepers of the threshold have gathered of the people.
verses.en_bbe: Go up to Hilkiah, the chief priest, and let him give out the money which is taken into the house of the Lord, which the keepers of the door have got together from the people;

verses.en: And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD: and let them give it to the doers of the work which is in the house of the LORD, to repair the breaches of the house,
verses.pt: e que só entreguem na mão dos mestres de obra que estão encarregados da casa do Senhor; e que estes o dêem aos que fazem a obra, aos que estão na casa do Senhor para repararem os estragos da casa,
verses.en_web: Let them deliver it into the hand of the workmen who have the oversight of Yahweh’s house; and let them give it to the workmen who are in Yahweh’s house, to repair the damage to the house,
verses.en_bbe: And let it be given to the overseers of the work of the Lord's house, to give to the workmen who are making good what was damaged in the house of the Lord;

verses.en: Unto carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.
verses.pt: aos carpinteiros, aos edificadores, e aos pedreiros. e que comprem madeira e pedras lavradas, a fim de repararem a casa.
verses.en_web: to the carpenters, and to the builders, and to the masons, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the house.
verses.en_bbe: To the woodworkers and the builders and the stone-cutters; and for getting wood and cut stones for the building up of the house.

verses.en: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand, because they dealt faithfully.
verses.pt: Contudo não se tomava conta a eles do dinheiro que se lhes entregava nas mãos, porquanto se haviam com fidelidade.
verses.en_web: However there was no accounting made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand; for they dealt faithfully.”
verses.en_bbe: They did not have to give any account of the money which was handed to them, for they made use of it with good faith.

verses.en: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
verses.pt: Então disse o sumo sacerdote Hilquias ao escrivão Safã: Achei o livro da lei na casa do Senhor. E Hilquias entregou o livro a Safã, e ele o leu.
verses.en_web: Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the book of the law in Yahweh’s house.” Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
verses.en_bbe: Then Hilkiah, the chief priest, said to Shaphan the scribe, I have made discovery of the book of the law in the house of the Lord. So Hilkiah gave it to Shaphan;

verses.en: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD.
verses.pt: Depois o escrivão Safã veio ter com o rei e, dando ao rei o relatório, disse: Teus servos despejaram o dinheiro que se achou na casa, e o entregaram na mão dos mestres de obra que estão encarregados da casa do Senhor.
verses.en_web: Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, “Your servants have emptied out the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hands of the workmen who have the oversight of Yahweh’s house.”
verses.en_bbe: Then, after reading it, Shaphan the scribe went in to the king and gave him an account of what had been done, saying, Your servants have given out the money which was in the house, and have given it to the overseers of the work of the house of the Lord.

verses.en: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.
verses.pt: Safã, o escrivão, falou ainda ao rei, dizendo: O sacerdote Hilquias me entregou um livro. E Safã o leu diante do rei.
verses.en_web: Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, “Hilkiah the priest has delivered a book to me.” Then Shaphan read it before the king.
verses.en_bbe: Then Shaphan the scribe said to the king, Hilkiah the priest has given me a book; and he was reading it before the king.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.
verses.pt: E sucedeu que, tendo o rei ouvido as palavras do livro da lei, rasgou as suas vestes.
verses.en_web: When the king had heard the words of the book of the law, he tore his clothes.
verses.en_bbe: And the king, hearing the words of the book of the law, took his robe in his hands, violently parting it as a sign of his grief;

verses.en: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Achbor the son of Michaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asahiah a servant of the king’s, saying,
verses.pt: Então o rei deu ordem a Hilquias, o sacerdote, a Aicão, filho de Safã, a Acbor, filho de Micaías, a Safã, o escrivão, e Asaías, servo do rei, dizendo:
verses.en_web: The king commanded Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Achbor the son of Micaiah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And he gave orders to Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, and Achbor, the son of Micaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king's servant, saying,

verses.en: Go ye, enquire of the LORD for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found: for great is the wrath of the LORD that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book, to do according unto all that which is written concerning us.
verses.pt: Ide, consultai ao Senhor por mim, e pelo povo, e por todo o Judá, acerca das palavras deste livro que se achou; porque grande é o furor do Senhor, que se acendeu contra nós, porquanto nossos pais não deram ouvidos às palavras deste livro, para fazerem conforme tudo quanto acerca de nós está escrito.
verses.en_web: “Go inquire of Yahweh for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found; for great is Yahweh’s wrath that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not listened to the words of this book, to do according to all that which is written concerning us.”
verses.en_bbe: Go and get directions from the Lord for me and for the people and for all Judah, about the words of this book which has come to light; for great is the wrath of the Lord which is burning against us, because our fathers have not given ear to the words of this book, to do all the things which are recorded in it.

verses.en: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asahiah, went unto Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college;) and they communed with her.
verses.pt: Então o sacerdote Hilquias, e Aicão, e Acbor, e Safã, e Asaías foram ter com a profetisa Hulda, mulher de Salum, filho de Ticvá, filho de Harás, o guarda das vestiduras (ela habitava então em Jerusalém, na segunda parte), e lhe falaram.
verses.en_web: So Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe (now she lived in Jerusalem in the second quarter); and they talked with her.
verses.en_bbe: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam and Achbor and Shaphan and Asaiah, went to Huldah the woman prophet, the wife of Shallum, the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the robes, (now she was living in Jerusalem, in the second part of the town;) and they had talk with her.

verses.en: And she said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell the man that sent you to me,
verses.pt: E ela lhes respondeu: Assim diz o Senhor, o Deus de Israel: Dizei ao homem que vos enviou a mim:
verses.en_web: She said to them, “Yahweh the God of Israel says, ‘Tell the man who sent you to me,
verses.en_bbe: And she said to them, The Lord, the God of Israel, says, Say to the man who sent you to me,

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read:
verses.pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Eis que trarei males sobre este lugar e sobre os seus habitantes, conforme todas as palavras do livro que o rei de Judá leu.
verses.en_web: “Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will bring evil on this place, and on its inhabitants, even all the words of the book which the king of Judah has read.
verses.en_bbe: These are the words of the Lord: See, I will send evil on this place and on its people, even everything which the king of Judah has been reading in the book;

verses.en: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and shall not be quenched.
verses.pt: Porquanto me deixaram, e queimaram incenso a outros deuses, para me provocarem à ira por todas as obras das suas mãos, o meu furor se acendeu contra este lugar, e não se apagará.
verses.en_web: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the work of their hands, therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and it will not be quenched.’”
verses.en_bbe: Because they have given me up, burning offerings to other gods and moving me to wrath by all the work of their hands; so my wrath will be on fire against this place, and will not be put out.

verses.en: But to the king of Judah which sent you to enquire of the LORD, thus shall ye say to him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, As touching the words which thou hast heard;
verses.pt: Todavia ao rei de Judá, que vos enviou para consultar ao Senhor, assim lhe direis: Assim diz o Senhor, o Deus de Israel: Quanto às palavras que ouviste,
verses.en_web: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of Yahweh, tell him, “Yahweh the God of Israel says, ‘Concerning the words which you have heard,
verses.en_bbe: But to the king of Judah who sent you to get directions from the Lord, say, This is what the Lord, the God of Israel, has said: As to the words which have come to your ears,

verses.en: Because thine heart was tender, and thou hast humbled thyself before the LORD, when thou heardest what I spake against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and hast rent thy clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard thee, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: porquanto o teu coração se enterneceu, e te humilhaste perante o Senhor, quando ouviste o que falei contra este lugar, e contra os seus habitantes, isto é, que se haviam de tornar em assolação e em maldição, e rasgaste as tuas vestes, e choraste perante mim, também eu te ouvi, diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: because your heart was tender, and you humbled yourself before Yahweh, when you heard what I spoke against this place, and against its inhabitants, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and have torn your clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard you,’ says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Because your heart was soft, and you made yourself low before me, when you had word of what I said against this place and its people, that they would become a waste and a curse, and you gave signs of grief, weeping before me: truly, I have given ear to you, says the Lord.

verses.en: Behold therefore, I will gather thee unto thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place. And they brought the king word again.
verses.pt: Pelo que eu te recolherei a teus pais, e tu serás recolhido em paz à tua sepultura, e os teus olhos não verão todo o mal que hei de trazer sobre este lugar. Então voltaram, levando a resposta ao rei.
verses.en_web: ‘Therefore behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes will not see all the evil which I will bring on this place.’”’” So they brought this message back to the king.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause I will let you go to your fathers and be put in your last resting-place in peace, and your eyes will not see all the evil which I will send on this place. So they took this news back to the king.
